svg.title: Illustrative Michaelis–Menten curves across two concentration ranges
svg.desc: Curve A has Vmax=1 and Km=1; curve B has Vmax=2 and Km=2. Both have slope 1 at zero. The curves are close over 0 to 0.15 but approach different limiting rates over 0 to 12. All quantities are arbitrary mathematical units, not archived experimental data.
